The best place to learn about Radix is the Radix Full Stack site or the RadFi 2022 Keynote.

The core Radix belief is that the future of finance is decentralized.

But Web3 and DeFi today are afflicted by some serious problems. The platforms that launched DeFi, including Ethereum and others, will not be capable of supporting billions of users and trillions of dollars of assets. 

Luckily, Radix is a Full Stack of technologies designed to solve precisely that - a platform that can underpin a $1,000+ trillion Web3/DeFi through to the end of this century and beyond. That’s the purpose of Radix - a platform that can propel DeFi into the mainstream.

The table below summarizes some of these problems and how Radix  solves them.

#

Web3 & DeFi today offers

Radix Solutions and Reading

1

Poor User Experience as technically difficult and insecure practices such as blind signing and seed phrases are forced upon on end users.

• Mobile Radix Wallet that allows your friends and family to confidently use Web3 and DeFi.

• Five core platform technologies introduced as part of the Radix Babylon Mainnet upgrade:

• Transaction Manifest

• Personas

• Smart Accounts

• Native Assets

• Radix Connect

Reading:

• The Problem with Crypto Wallets Today

2

Poor Security with hacks, bugs, and exploits totalling billions of dollars being commonplace.

• Radix Engine v2 - Custom-built execution environment for DeFi.

• Scrypto - Custom-built programming language with asset-orientedarchitecture

• Blueprints and Components - Reusable, modular and more composable smart contracts

• Transaction Manifest - Powerful transaction layer offering on-the-fly composability

• Blueprint Catalog - On-ledger library of smart contract blueprints

• Badges and native features for Role Based Access Control

Reading:

• The Problem with Smart Contracts Today

• Radix Engine v2: An Asset-Oriented Smart Contract Environment

• Scrypto: An Asset-Oriented Smart Contract Language

• The Problem with Crypto Transactions Today

• Radix’s Asset-Oriented Transactions

• Comparing Virtual Machines: Message Only vs Asset-Oriented

• See Rekt Retweet series linked in further reading below

3

Poor Developer Experience resulting in slow and hard-to-learn development because of unintuitive programming languages and lack of native in-built features for assets, transactions and access control.

4

Developer incentives that overly rely on the issuance of tokens such as governance tokens.

• Radix Developer Royalties - Automated on-ledger royalty fees set by developers

Reading:

• On-ledger, Recurring Developer Revenue. Incentives to Buidl

• Radix Tech Docs

5

Scalability that breaks atomic composability,sacrificing the compounding innovation of Web3andDeFi.

• Cerberus - Peer-reviewed consensus protocol offering unlimited linear scalability and atomic composability.

Reading:

• Cerberus Consensus: Peer Reviewed

• Cerberus Infographic Series
